QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Crimsonheart Castle
QuestInfo.0:
Grendel the Really Old has discovered a strange message in his Dimensional Library that seems to be a call for aid in the long-lost land of Tynerum. Help the peaceful demons of Tynerum escape their terrible fate in an adventure of myth and magic.

-#eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 130 - 135
-#eRoute#n
1) Accept the quest, 'Reading with Grendel'
2)Take the Dimensional Mirror to Tynerum

 -#eFinal Reward#n
